findings.summary: The 'realized by their potentials' clause is absent from next_runInvariant's conclusion, which keeps only divergence-freeness. It holds definitionally for the mean increments and by separate curl theorems for the two wave increments.

(9.10) is preserved as ZeroMassesOn G.region.carrier, not at every slow point. The carrier is the chart's slow domain, on which every other bound of the invariant is also stated, so this is the paper's identity.

Lean adds the hypothesis geometricThreshold ≤ N0 and uses a strengthened invariant (chart coherence, torus periodicity, pressure W_1, covariance M_1, flat errors). These encode construction parameters and Definition 9.4's 'as in Proposition 9.3'; the actual run satisfies them.
